newsitem.title: USA: MCI chief blasts Baby Bells on competition.
newsitem.headline: MCI chief blasts Baby Bells on competition.

text.p: The chairman of MCI Communications Corp blasted the Baby Bell phone companies Monday, accusing them of seeking to block government efforts to open the local phone market to competition.
"The only 'Bell' practicing true competition is Taco Bell," Bert Roberts told an audience at the National Press Club, referring to the fast-food restaurant chain.
He said the regional Bells and local phone provider GTE Corp. were trying to block competition "with every instrument at their disposal."
GTE and the Bells are seeking to overturn in court the Federal Communications Commission "interconnection" order aimed at breaking open local phone monopolies.

A U.S. appeals court in St. Louis recently suspended key provisions of the order while it considers the challenges to the measure. The Justice Department, the FCC, MCI and other long-distance carriers have asked the U.S. Supreme Court to lift the lower court's "stay."
